artifact.canonical_name: Capability Gates Are Not Authorization: Confused-Deputy Failures in LLM Agent Frameworks

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.28679v1
sources.role: Primary source used for chronology and technical verification

claims.text: The authors distinguish tool capability exposure from per-call authorization and demonstrate confused-deputy risks in common agent frameworks.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.finding: The paper audits pinned public-source versions of LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and Stripe Agent Toolkit, finding default capability gates but no deterministic fail-closed per-call value authorization gate; it evaluates a ScopeGate control.

editorial.why_now_note: This June paper materially informs the month-level theme and is suitable for Candidate Selection.
